name: agent-harness
description: Portable agent harness for opencode, Antigravity and Claude Code. See README.md.
comment: The only runtime dependency is for opencode's plugin/resume.js, which imports @opencode-ai/plugin. Because ~/.config/opencode/plugin is a symlink into this kit, Node resolves that import from here, not from ~/.config/opencode/node_modules. Run `npm install --omit=dev` in the kit root after cloning, or let install.sh do it.
